name: nemerle-nitra
displayName: Nemerle (with Nitra grammar and space blocks)
description: Nemerle language support through nemerle-lsp: Nemerle's own parser plus unmodified Nitra for grammar and space blocks.

nemerle.languageServer.path.description: Path to the nemerle-lsp launcher (built by baseline/build-language-server.py).

nemerle.languageServer.references.description: Optional .NET reference assembly directory passed as --references.

nemerle.languageServer.log.description: Optional log file for the server.

nemerle.languageServer.sourceRoot.description: Root directory for file module paths (default: the workspace folder).

nemerle.languageServer.fileNameNamespace.description: A file's namespace is its file name only (-file-name-namespaces).

nemerle.languageServer.legacyNamespaces.description: TEMPORARY: parse classic namespace declarations (-legacy-namespaces) for code not migrated yet.
